result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: transition assistance is available on expiry or termination for up to six months at then-current rates; Customer Data must be returned within 30 days of request in a complete, commonly used, machine-readable format; and remaining data must then be securely deleted with written officer certification. The revision appropriately replaces only the contradictory immediate-cessation and deletion language in Section 11.1 while preserving the more protective existing provisions in Sections 11.2 and 11.3. The drafting is clear, internally consistent, and professional.
